summary: Creative Realities, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the commencement of a public underwritten offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants (Item 7.01 Regulation FD). The filing also disclosed preliminary Q2 2026 financial estimates (revenue $21M-$23M; Adjusted EBITDA $2.0M-$2.2M). No specific deal terms, advisor, or recommendation were provided. The offering is an ordinary capital-raising event, not a special situation. Watch for pricing and use of proceeds.
